georeferenced_official_paddock_boundarie: Georeferenced official paddock boundaries · Paddock-specific environmental summaries · Livestock numbers · Pasture carrying capacity · Watering points
satellite_ndvi_and_era5_precipitation_te: Satellite NDVI and ERA5 precipitation, temperature and surface soil moisture are summarized for a 5 km analysis zone around 44.916664, 64.712612. All four paddock schedules use this shared signal until the official plan map is georeferenced. The four displayed sectors are illustrative, not official boundaries. The 2026 rotation schedule is retained as the official-plan baseline; exact seasonal dates remain assumptions. Water access is not assessed. The historical evaluation applies these seasonal rules retrospectively to observed conditions; it does not establish actual past grazing, predictive skill or field outcomes.

how_the_score_and_decisions_work: How the score and decisions work
score_50_vegetation_stress_30_rainfall_s: Score = 50% vegetation stress + 30% rainfall stress + 20% soil moisture / heat stress.
vegetation_reaches_100_stress_at_35_rain: Vegetation reaches 100 stress at −35%; rainfall at −50%. Normal / slightly below normal / below normal soil moisture maps to 0 / 40 / 100. Heat reaches 100 at +4°C. Soil and heat are averaged. Components are capped at 0–100, then the final score is rounded to an integer.
0_30_low_planned_grazing_may_proceed_31: 0–30 LOW: planned grazing may proceed. 31–60 MODERATE: monitor / reduce pressure. 61–100 HIGH: delay grazing. Scheduled rest always takes precedence. These are illustrative thresholds, not validated agronomic limits.
the_score_weights_and_recommendation_thr: The score weights and recommendation thresholds are unchanged. Imported NDVI, precipitation, temperature and soil moisture use the stated current/reference periods. Soil categories are a provisional interpretation of reanalysis anomalies. Water access does not affect the score.
observed_rows_calculate_anomalies_from_t: Observed rows calculate anomalies from the imported period and historical reference; demo rows retain synthetic expectations. Soil moisture remains DEMO where labeled. Water access does not affect the score.

precipitation_is_the_period_total_rain_p: Precipitation is the period total (rain plus snow); temperature is the daily-mean average. ERA5 is a coarse grid reanalysis at the pilot centroid, not a pasture weather-station measurement. The existing rainfall score input uses the precipitation anomaly.

pixelwise_median_composites_at_20_m_with: Pixelwise median composites at 20 m, with at least two clear observations per pixel. Current and historical means use exactly the same valid land footprint ({p0} of the buffer). The baseline is the equal-weight mean of five historical composites. Water and other excluded pixels are not represented.
these_are_shared_pilot_area_indicators_n: These are shared pilot-area indicators, not measurements of the individual illustrated paddocks. The buffer includes land around the village and has not been restricted to legally designated pasture.
current_ndvi_is_the_median_of_polygon_me: Current NDVI is the median of polygon-mean scene NDVI; baseline is the equal-weight mean of historical annual medians.
observed_satellite_data_sentinel_2_l2a_e: Observed satellite data · Sentinel-2 L2A · ERA5 reanalysis data · Approximate analysis zone: Akkum 5 km buffer.
observed_conditions_compared_with_the_20: Observed conditions compared with the 2026-style seasonal rules. This does not establish predictive accuracy, actual historical grazing decisions or avoided losses.
the_september_2026_assessment_remains_av: The September 2026 assessment remains available in its separate tab as a reference. This retrospective case does not validate ecological outcomes or predictive performance.
observed_window_p0_to_p1_historical_refe: Observed window: {p0} to {p1}. Historical reference: same calendar period in {p2}.
chart_shows_the_selected_year_up_to_the: Chart shows the selected year up to the slider date. Missing or unscored windows remain gaps; monthly reference footprints can differ.
no_meaningful_observed_grazing_conflict_: No meaningful observed grazing conflict was found in the evaluable 2021–2026 windows. No synthetic case is substituted. Gaps remain unassessed.
screening_summary: {p0} of {p1} monthly windows evaluated; {p2} overlap planned grazing with moderate or high stress. Screening: March–November 2021–2025 and March–September 2026.
the_highlighted_case_has_the_highest_unc: The highlighted case has the highest unchanged score among evaluable monthly grazing windows; earliest date breaks ties. References exclude the assessed year but can include later years. October–November 2026 were incomplete at acquisition and are excluded.
trailing_30_day_month_end_windows_scene_: Trailing 30-day month-end windows. Scene cloud cover below 60%; SCL vegetation/bare-land mask, at least 70% clear land coverage per accepted scene. Pixelwise median with at least two clear dates per pixel. Same-calendar comparisons share a common land footprint of at least 70% and require at least three other years. Baselines are equal-weight means of available annual windows, not 30-year normals.
era5_precipitation_includes_rain_and_sno: ERA5 precipitation includes rain and snow; the existing rainfall score uses its anomaly. Climate is a coarse centroid grid estimate. Soil status uses the unchanged anomaly thresholds: below −20% = Below normal, below −10% = Slightly below normal, otherwise Normal. Score weights and seasonal recommendation rules are unchanged.
